svg.title: Глава 8 — Сетевая безопасность: итоговая шпаргалка
svg.desc: Вся глава: principles → attacks/controls → crypto → PKI/auth → IPsec/Wi-Fi → PGP/Web → social issues
svg.text: Вся глава: principles → attacks/controls → crypto → PKI/auth → IPsec/Wi-Fi → PGP/Web → social issues

text.tspan: Goals: confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, nonrepudiation.
Design: simplicity, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, least privilege.
Security is a system property, not one algorithm.
Reconnaissance builds knowledge of hosts/services/topology.
Interception exposes traffic; spoofing/tampering changes identity/data.
Disruption attacks availability.
Firewall, IDS and IPS have distinct filtering/detection/prevention roles.
Algorithm may be public; secret resides in key.
DES/3DES and AES illustrate block ciphers.
Modes turn block primitive into usable encryption scheme.
Freshness/redundancy help resist active manipulation/replay.
Public/private keys separate encryption/decryption roles.
RSA relies on difficulty of factoring large values.
Elliptic-curve context uses hard discrete-log problems.
Hashes/message digests enable efficient digital signatures.
Signature protects authenticity/integrity, not secrecy by itself.
Certificate binds identity to a public key.
CA signs certificates; chains terminate at trust anchors.
Authentication protocols require careful message ordering.
Nonces/timestamps provide freshness against replay.
KDC/Kerberos/Diffie-Hellman/public-key auth solve different parts.
IPsec protects IP traffic; transport and tunnel modes differ.
VPN commonly uses tunnel-style protected paths.
Wireless security moved from weak WEP to 802.11i/WPA2.
Correct configuration and key handling remain part of security.
PGP: hash/sign → compress → session-key encrypt → protect session key.
DNSSEC authenticates DNS data, not DNS confidentiality.
SSL/TLS creates authenticated confidential integrity-protected channel.
Browser executable content expands attack surface.
Sandboxing/code signing constrain mobile code.
Authorized only: traceroute for path observation.
tcpdump/Wireshark for traffic capture and protocol inspection.
telnet is mentioned as generic connection tool.
IDS evaluation must include false positives and false negatives.
Source gives no universal firewall/IPsec/TLS configuration CLI.
Privacy and anonymity can conflict with surveillance requirements.
Censorship and steganography change communication visibility.
Copyright/DRM create competing user/rightsholder interests.
Technical mechanisms do not resolve policy conflicts by themselves.

svg.text: Provenance: RAG p0814:c01–p0960:c01 · detailed visual covers sections 8.1–8.14
